The [[Keeper of the Scythe]] is one of the [[Forgotten]] collectors who award [[Forgotten weapon]]s in exchange for a [[Book of Secrets]], the [[Nightfall]] end-game reward item. 

==Location==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"I have never been fond of humans, despite our ancient purpose. But you... ah, yes. You have earned more than acclaim. You have earned respect. Therefore, I will help you where I would ordinarily not lift a finger for your kind. Bring me 1 Book of Secrets, and I will create for you a gift that rival the treasure of kings."''
